# Modernization Workbook

A clean, standalone project for federal IT modernization. Content is written for reuse without internal branding or source-system identifiers.

## What lives here

- **SQL Server Identity Transformation** — an eleven-book reading sequence on moving from Windows Authentication to cloud identity authentication for SQL Server.
- **Client-Server to Hybrid-Cloud** — the architectural narrative of the modernization journey.
- **Whitepapers** — long-form analyses of specific modernization topics.
- **Principles** — the governing ideas that shape the work.
- **Compliance Series** — federal compliance documentation organized by volume.
- **Case Studies** — deployment patterns and lessons learned.
- **Executive Briefs** — single-page leadership summaries.

## Download as DOCX

Every page renders to Microsoft Word (`.docx`) alongside the HTML view. Use the DOCX link in the page header, or access the file directly.

A complete series can be downloaded as a ZIP from the series index pages.
